releaseNotes:
﻿## Conferences & meals

- Day guests are included in meal headcounts on conference overview, kitchen/weekly meals, and statistics
- Undated day guests use the full stay for meals (same window as overnight guests)
- Conference overview shows an on-screen Meals section with overnight + day guest counts

## Bookings & rooms

- Sleeping-room bed capacity is enforced for overnight guests (day guests do not use beds)

## Security & access

- Dashboard areas respect permission areas for read access
- Permanent guest delete removes linked mail attachments after anonymizing bookings
- Login throttle and safer URL fetching for recipe import

## Fixes

- Shared meal attendance rules so day guests are not dropped from counts
